# KiCad standard footprints

These unmodified footprint files are from the [KiCad Footprints library](https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints), by the KiCad library contributors, as shipped with KiCad 10 (footprint format 20260206).

| File | Upstream library |
|---|---|
| `DIP-14_W7.62mm.kicad_mod` | `Package_DIP.pretty` |
| `C_Disc_D5.0mm_W2.5mm_P5.00mm.kicad_mod` | `Capacitor_THT.pretty` |
| `PinHeader_1x02_P2.54mm_Vertical.kicad_mod` | `Connector_PinHeader_2.54mm.pretty` |

The library data is distributed under [CC BY-SA 4.0 with KiCad's design exception](LICENSE.md) ([upstream license](https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints/-/blob/10.0.4/LICENSE.md)).
